_doc: ⚑ S394 (UiB job 27 Part B1–B3; S392, S390 before it) — THE LAMBY SET (LambyVision, src/room/lambyVision.ts) in its three places, how it is brought close, the bar under its picture, Lamby's line in view, and the moment's clock. One set, the same in all three rooms: the tapes change, the set does not. `place.pos` is the floor point under its hooves (world metres), `place.yaw` the turn about Y (0 = its glass faces +z/south; 180 north; −90 west). `seat` is the seat's eye (the probes' seat poses). Measured from the seat (tools/s394-lamby-tv-probe.mjs): 1997 on the chest of drawers behind Daniel's seat, ~120° right of the desk, ~2 m; 2016 on the low white unit by Vera's door (the south wall), ~90° left of the desk, ~1.4 m; 2026 on Maya's shelf plank where her old CRT stood, ahead and a little up, ~1.4 m.

1997._docPlace: on tvDresser (top y 0.58), facing into the room (west), where job 26 B put the TV; the VCR, the CRT, its panel and the VHS sleeve are gone from r1 (the set is all of them now)

2016._docPlace: on wallTvUnit (top y 0.45), facing the seat (north); the wall TV, its DVD player, tray, light and the course's case are gone from r3

2026._docPlace: on e_shelfPlank (top y 1.14), facing the seat (south): Maya's shelf CRT (e_crtBody/e_crtBezel/e_crtScreen) is transformed into the set — her object kept, made an object of the time; the cream 2026 display on its arm (e26Display…) is gone from r4

held._doc: BROUGHT CLOSE (heldDevice's grammar). In a headset the glass comes `xrDist` m before the eyes (Meta's 0.5 m floor for anything looked at for long; ⚑ the headset seat's own monitor is 0.56 m from the eye — S374 — so at 0.6 the 1997 CRT stood in front of the set's glass in the probe's photographs: at 0.5 the set's face is the nearest thing), and the set grows until its PICTURE is `pictureDeg` tall (the brief: 25–30°). On a computer or a phone the set keeps its size and comes to the distance where its face — the glass's top to the keys' foot, 0.374 m — fills `flatFill` of the view's height, never more than `flatMaxW` of its width (a portrait phone). The travel keeps `clearance` m from the eye and takes liftBase + liftPerMetre × the distance, at most liftMax s (smoothstep). `glowRest`/`glowHeld`: the body's self-light share (the 'system' tier's 0.34 in the room; more in the hand, its face turned from the lamp). `xrKey`: a key catches a headset's ray within this many metres (heldDevice's XR_BUTTON, wider for a larger key).

bar._doc: THE BAR UNDER THE PICTURE (B2; Part A's A1): the glass is 960 × 720, the picture its upper 540 px, the bar the lower 180 px (a third of the picture). Capital heights in canvas px of that 540-px picture: the caption `captionCap` (≈ 1/22 of the picture), the margin `marginCap` (≈ 1/27); a full bar steps both down, never under `floorCap` — 1.0° at the headset's 28° picture (540 / 28 = 19.3 px a degree).

call._doc: LAMBY'S LINE IN VIEW (B3): a card `w` m wide, `drop` degrees under the line of sight, `flatDist` m from the camera / `xrDist` m from the eyes (drawn over the room: nothing cuts it); turned more than `followDeg` away, it glides back into view over `follow` s.

moment._doc: The moment's clock (no turns, no fades): `callHold` = the longest Lamby's line is given to be read before the set comes anyway (its yes sends it at once); `dismissBreath` = after × the set comes this long after; `noCall` = a call that never showed (the era's cap) lets the set come after this; `afterHold` = the end card held, the set in the hand, before the floor is free again; `afterDad` = the seconds Dad's two lines are given before his link; `noPlayRelease` = a tape that will not start lets the moment go after this.
